obernants.operator: At the real-model level, exclude nontriangular Cholesky factors or A!=L*Lᵀ, triangular solutions with T*x!=b, and least-squares candidates with Aᵀ(A*x-b)!=0. These exact exclusions describe targets, not an exact-equality acceptance test for f64 outputs. The native relation excludes reports differing from rounded factor/solve transitions, incorrect recomputed reconstruction/primal/normal residuals, or a stationary Converged status when its computed residual exceeds tolerance. A small native residual does not exclude large coordinate error on ill-conditioned inputs; numerical rank is not certified by unpivoted QR.

obernants.operator: For fixed real triangular T and observed x, compatible right sides satisfy b=T*x; allowing T to vary gives many systems with the same solution. For fixed full-column-rank A, the real QR least-squares fiber for x is b=A*x+z with Aᵀz=0, so nonzero orthogonal residuals remain compatible. A real positive-diagonal Cholesky factor uniquely determines A=L*Lᵀ, while rounded native factor/report fibers can include neighboring matrices. Stationary output plus residual/status leaves many initial vectors, budgets and systems compatible; native antecedents must reproduce the rounded execution, not merely these real identities.
